body: Root-caused the Target 'Voting Results from Annual Meeting of Shareholders' misclassification found during S170-07's dividend-watcher regeneration: dividend.Classify ran over the full page body, which includes PRNewswire's 'Also from this source' related-articles widget teasing a real but different Target press release further down the same page. Not a rare edge case -- 2358 occurrences across the full var/prwatch-body corpus. Added prspam.StripRelatedArticles, wired into dividend-watcher before classification. Hand-checked the one other borderline record (OceanaGold) before touching it -- real CEO quote, not a bug, left alone. Regenerated var/dividends/dividends.ndjson (7 -> 6 records). Rebuilt and restarted fatbaby-dividend-watcher.service. Commits daaa917, d6c0ac4.
title: S170-231: dividend-watcher fabricated a raise signal from a related-article widget
